name: CyberSpark cybersecurity camp (Virginia Tech)
org: Virginia Tech College of Engineering, DoD Senior Military College Cyber Institute
what_you_do: Do hands-on cybersecurity activities. Virginia Tech staff and faculty lead them. You also learn about careers in the field. No experience is needed.
who_can_apply: Rising 8th and 9th grade students. Any student who might like cybersecurity is welcome. You do not need any previous experience.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: 2026 camps: July 6 to 10 in Blacksburg and July 27 to 31 in Arlington, VA. Applications closed March 24, 2026 and decisions were emailed April 17, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the application link on the CyberSpark page. Phone: 540-231-4312.
notes: Mostly for younger teens (rising 8th and 9th graders). Cost and whether it is a day camp or overnight are not stated, so ask the program. Camp, not a job.
